# gifenc

`gifenc.js` is the ESM distribution of gifenc **1.0.3**, obtained from the npm package with lifecycle scripts disabled. Only its unavailable source-map reference was removed. The adjacent declaration describes only the API used here. The MIT license is retained in `gifenc-LICENSE.md`.

Upstream: https://github.com/mattdesl/gifenc

It is bundled into the native plugin bridge. Vendoring keeps the corresponding Vencord source archive independently buildable with its pinned upstream lockfile; users need no external encoder.
